breaking_news.headline: How Aldi is pushing down grocery prices
breaking_news.summary: The German-owned chain's low prices are winning over shoppers — and pushing competitors to respond.

breaking_news.headline: After a year of uncertainty, Job Corps is making a comeback
breaking_news.summary: Last year, President Trump ordered more than 100 Job Corps training programs to close to save federal funds. A lawsuit stopped that, and now enrollment is up for "AI-proof" trade career training.

breaking_news.headline: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio
breaking_news.summary: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

breaking_news.headline: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
breaking_news.summary: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.

breaking_news.headline: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged  — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.

breaking_news.headline: Business as a liberal art? Some high schools say yes
breaking_news.summary: Learning about money is becoming a growing part of the high school curriculum.

breaking_news.headline: Tariffs, diesel and computer chips are driving up costs for automakers
breaking_news.summary: American auto companies say they are paying more for key components like computer chips, steel and copper — plus the fuel needed to transport their products.

breaking_news.headline: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
breaking_news.summary: GDP grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter in the last major read on the economy ahead of the midterm elections — but many Americans continue to struggle with affordability.

breaking_news.headline: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering
breaking_news.summary: Xi's anti-corruption campaign has become "an effort to consolidate and maintain authority", observers say.

breaking_news.headline: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
breaking_news.summary: With 99% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

breaking_news.headline: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
breaking_news.summary: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.

breaking_news.headline: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
breaking_news.summary: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.

breaking_news.headline: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
breaking_news.summary: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

breaking_news.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
breaking_news.summary: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

breaking_news.headline: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
breaking_news.summary: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

breaking_news.headline: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash
breaking_news.summary: The recordings appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move even though another up ahead had stalled.

breaking_news.headline: What we now know about the UK economy in four charts
breaking_news.summary: The Office for Budget Responsibility says higher energy prices will impact everything from prices and living standards to economic growth.

breaking_news.headline: DoorDash to buy Instacart in $17bn deal it says will expand customer options
breaking_news.summary: Instacart shoppers will be able to buy from 150,000 stores, compared to the 100,000 currently available on the platform, the firms said.

breaking_news.headline: 'I live with a ghost' - inside the haunted homes attracting bargain hunters
breaking_news.summary: Properties where someone has died in tragic circumstances can have big reductions in price.

breaking_news.headline: I earn £30,000. I'm angry there was no fuel duty cut in the Budget
breaking_news.summary: People on a range of incomes from £4,062 to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they made of this year's Budget.
